children: Turn Therapeutics appointed Robert R. Redfield as Chief Scientific Officer to advance scientific and clinical strategy for GX-03.
Appointed Robert R. Redfield, former CDC Director, as Chief Scientific Officer to strengthen immunology and public-health expertise.
Dr. Redfield will guide scientific and clinical strategy for GX-03 across atopic dermatitis, onychomycosis, hidradenitis suppurativa and other indications.
Focus areas include cytokine signaling and host inflammatory response to microbial stimuli, core to Turn’s targeted, non-systemic approach.
Company cites preclinical effects on IL-36 and IL-31 and interim data showing strong efficacy and safety for GX-03.
